label: rem:fibre-functor-atlas-affine-charts
title: Fibre-functor gerbe as the affine atlas
html: Every fibre functor \tau' \colon \mathbf{C} \to R\text{-}\mathbf{Mod} serves as an affine chart, realizing the abstract categorical data over R; the canonical functor \tau yields the contact affine chart on \mathbb{P}(V). Under this reading each monoidal natural isomorphism acts as a transition function changing affine coordinates, so the G-gerbe of fibre functors is precisely the affine atlas of the quantum universe.
